palette_unification.reason: union is 429 RGBA colors (256 opaque) >> 24; palettes are pairwise disjoint (all off-diagonal Jaccard = 0.0). A nearest-color remap onto a 429+ color 'union' would change nothing; forcing a shared 16-color palette would be a lossy global requantization, not a deterministic fix.

speckle_removal.condition: isolated opaque pixel with all 8 neighbors transparent
speckle_removal.reason: isolated pixels cannot belong to the intended silhouette (silhouettes are connected blobs); removal disconnects nothing by construction.

outline_unification.condition: 3+ distinct most-common boundary colors across the 16 icons
outline_unification.reason: boundary colors are per-icon artifacts of quantization; unifying them to the set median is a deterministic cosmetic outline fix.
